cards.card_text: Job wants his words to last, written with an iron stylus on lead or chiseled in ___ forever.
cards.verse_text: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.
cards.snippet: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.

cards.card_text: Now the prophet Isaiah tells what the LORD says to him next: take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
cards.snippet: …me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

cards.card_text: Next, the woodworker goes to work with a measuring line, a stylus, chisels and a compass.
cards.verse_text: The woodworker extends a measuring line; he marks it out with a stylus; he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass.
cards.snippet: The woodworker extends a measuring line; he marks it out with a stylus; he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass.

cards.card_text: It's written with an iron stylus and engraved with a diamond point, and that is NOT a sticky note on the fridge.
cards.verse_text: “The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, engraved with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
cards.snippet: “The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, engraved with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and…
